svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Search LinkedIn by entering both the target company name and the name of the university I
currently attend, so that the results list people with the same background as me. → Obtain
referrals from current employees of the company I am applying to, since internship and fu
ll-time applications are competitive and a referral helps my resume be seen by recruiters.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Connect only with people who are currently employed at the target company and who attended
my university, skipping former employees and people who satisfy only one or none of these
requirements. → Obtain referrals from current employees of the company I am applying to,
since internship and full-time applications are competitive and a referral helps my resume
be seen by recruiters.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Open each candidate's profile to read their experience, and only send a connection request
when that experience matches the position I am targeting. → Obtain referrals from current
employees of the company I am applying to, since internship and full-time applications ar
e competitive and a referral helps my resume be seen by recruiters.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Send a connection note that introduces myself, says that I would like a referral for the p
osition, and mentions that I was also a student at the same university, to raise the chanc
e they agree to refer me. → Obtain referrals from current employees of the company I am ap
plying to, since internship and full-time applications are competitive and a referral help
s my resume be seen by recruiters.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Purchase LinkedIn Premium so that I can access as many potential connections as I want. →
Search LinkedIn by entering both the target company name and the name of the university I
currently attend, so that the results list people with the same background as me.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Adjust the search keywords — deleting one or two of them or making them more specific — so
that LinkedIn returns people with a more precise background. → Search LinkedIn by enterin
g both the target company name and the name of the university I currently attend, so that
the results list people with the same background as me.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Increase the number of connections shown on my LinkedIn profile. → Show the people who vie
w my profile that I am active on LinkedIn.

g.aria-label: 已否定联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 已否定联系 · 过程先后
Search LinkedIn by entering both the target company name and the name of the university I
currently attend, so that the results list people with the same background as me. → Send a
connection note that introduces myself, says that I would like a referral for the positio
n, and mentions that I was also a student at the same university, to raise the chance they
agree to refer me.
